categories.evidence: Carries the Validation label and alters assumeutxo chainstate cleanup and crash-recovery logic in src/validation.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes node startup failures caused by an interrupted assumeutxo snapshot cleanup leaving behind stale chainstate directories. According to the PR description, an interrupted cleanup leaves a nonempty directory such that 'renaming the background database to that occupied path fails and prevents startup from completing.'
